articles.summary: The best gifts have a way of saying, "I saw this and thought of you." Personalizing them says even more. Whether it's embroidered initials on a favorite tote, a meaningful phrase stitched onto a travel bag, or a heartfelt message tucked into a cozy throw blanket, personalization transforms an everyday gift into something that feels unmistakably hers. Personalization does not have to be stitched directly onto the bag. A keychain or charm add a splash of color and character to a zipper, while a silk scarf tied around a handle or shoulder strap is another simple way to make any bag feel more personal. At Vera Bradley, you can customize many of your favorite styles with monograms, patches embroidery, and personalized message tags that celebrate milestones, friendships, family traditions, and everyday moments worth remembering. Customized gifts for women blend style, functionality, and a personal story that endures long after the wrapping paper is gone. Best Personalized Gifts for Travel A favorite bag should always come along for the ride. Adding a name, initials, or meaningful phrase makes a personalized travel bag feel even more connected to the memories it's part of, whether you're celebrating a graduation, honeymoon, retirement, or someone's first big adventure. The Large Original Duffel Bag is ready for everything from weekend escapes to longer vacations. Its spacious interior makes packing easy, while three interior slip pockets and exterior pockets help keep travel essentials organized along the way. Personalized with embroidery or a monogram, it becomes a bag that's easy to spot at baggage claim and even easier to treasure for years to come. For travelers who like to keep everything organized, the Westover Hybrid Backpack checks every box. A dedicated laptop compartment, tablet sleeve, compression straps, trolley sleeve, and multiple zip compartments make it a smart choice for business trips, weekend getaways, and everyday adventures. Add a monogram or charm to create a travel companion that's every bit as practical as it is personal. If your gift recipient prefers a lightweight, versatile travel bag, the Large Berkhill Backpack is ready to go wherever the day leads. Exterior zip pockets, side pockets, organized interior storage, and a trolley sleeve make it equally useful for airports, road trips, and daily commutes. Personalization gives it an unmistakably one-of-a-kind finish. When you're shopping for personalized gifts for travel, it's often the thoughtful details that leave the biggest impression. A customized bag doesn't just carry belongings, it carries memories waiting to be made. Best Personalized Handbags & Totes Some bags become part of your daily routine before you even realize it. They're the ones you reach for without thinking because they simply work. Personalization makes those everyday favorites even more meaningful, turning monogrammed handbags and totes into thoughtful gifts she'll carry with confidence. The Original Vera Tote has earned its reputation as a timeless everyday essential. With six interior slip pockets, exterior storage, quilted cotton lining, and a secure zip closure, it's built to keep life organized while complementing just about any occasion. Personalization transforms this iconic tote into a gift that's both practical and unmistakably special. The Knollton Tote Bag is made for busy days that don't fit into one category. Whether she's heading to the office, catching a flight, or spending the weekend away, the spacious interior, dedicated laptop compartment, multiple organizational pockets, and built-in trolley sleeve keep everything within easy reach. Personalized embroidery, charms and a lovely silk scarf add a finishing touch that feels uniquely hers. Best Personalized Gift for Students Every semester brings something new. New classes, schedules, goals, and plenty to carry along the way. A personalized backpack makes campus life a little easier while adding a touch of individuality. Along with names and monograms, select Vera Bradley backpacks can be customized with patches and embroidered icons, giving students even more ways to show their personality. The Large Bancroft Backpack is designed to keep up with full schedules. Three spacious compartments, a laptop sleeve, water bottle pockets, organizer pockets, and a trolley sleeve help students stay organized from the first class of the day to weekend trips home. Adding enamel pins and bag charms takes this backpack from functional to fun. For lighter days around campus or weekends in the city, the Lorman Sling Backpack offers comfortable, hands-free convenience. Two zip compartments and an adjustable strap keep everyday essentials close without unnecessary bulk, making it a thoughtful gift for students who are always on the move. The Original Drawstring Backpack blends vintage-inspired charm with modern practicality. Its drawstring closure, magnetic flap, compact size, and adjustable straps create an easygoing style that works for classes, coffee runs, and everything in between. Add a monogram, patch, cute embroidered icon or charm to create a backpack that's easy to identify and unmistakably theirs. Best Personalized Gift for Moms, Sisters, or Friends Some gifts don't need a special occasion. They're simply a way to remind someone they're appreciated. Our Plush Throw Blanket becomes even more meaningful with a personalized message tag. Add a favorite quote, an important date, a shared memory, or a few heartfelt words to create a keepsake they'll reach for long after the occasion has passed. Sometimes the message is what they'll remember most. Our Knit Robe offers the same thoughtful opportunity. Soft, lightweight, and designed for everyday comfort, it's perfect for slow mornings, quiet evenings, and relaxing weekends at home. Pair it with a personalized message to create a gift that feels comforting long before it's ever worn. These are the kinds of monogrammed gifts for women that celebrate the people who make life brighter. They make wonderful gifts for friends, sisters, moms, daughters, bridesmaids, teachers, and anyone who deserves a thoughtful reminder that they're loved. Best Personalized Gift for Everyday Organization There's something satisfying about knowing exactly where everything is. Organization becomes even more enjoyable when the accessories you use every day reflect your own personal style. Our 3 Pouch Organizer Set helps organize everything from phone chargers and earbuds to travel essentials and everyday accessories. With three coordinating sizes, it's easy to keep bags, luggage, and drawers neat while adding a colorful personal touch. The Lay Flat Travel Organizer is designed for travelers who appreciate having everything within easy reach. Multiple zip compartments and mesh pockets help organize toiletries, cords, cosmetics, and other essentials, making packing and unpacking feel effortless. It's another thoughtful option for anyone shopping for personalized gifts for travel. A cosmetic bag is one of those accessories that's used almost every day, making it an especially meaningful personalized gift. Our Large Cosmetic Bag offers generous space for makeup, skincare, and toiletries, while the Medium Cosmetic Bag is perfectly sized for everyday essentials and quick touch-ups. Whether tucked inside a tote or packed for vacation, a monogrammed makeup bag adds a personal finishing touch that's as practical as it is beautiful. How to Personalize Your Gift We make it easy to add your own special touch to our bags and accessories. Once you have found the perfect gift, scroll down and look for the “Personalize this Style” button. Depending on the item, you can choose lettering, a stacked monogram, a patch, or an embroidered icon in a design that fits the recipient's personality. You can also finish the gift with a coordinating keychain, charm, or silk scarf. Have fun! Because the Best Gifts Feel Personal Anyone can give a beautiful bag or a cozy blanket. It's the personal touches that people remember years later. A favorite quote. Initials they'll carry every day. A meaningful date stitched into a keepsake they'll reach for again and again. Those thoughtful details turn everyday accessories into gifts with lasting meaning. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, graduation, holiday, bridal shower, Mother's Day, or simply reminding someone they're loved, Vera Bradley makes it easy to create gifts that feel one of a kind. From monogrammed handbags and totes to a personalized travel bag, a monogrammed makeup bag, or a cozy blanket with a heartfelt message, every personalized piece begins with beautiful craftsmanship and ends with a story that's uniquely theirs. articles.summary: The great travel backpack vs. tote debate has one very satisfying answer: it depends on your trip. A hands-free backpack can make airport connections and sightseeing days feel infinitely more manageable. A tote keeps essentials within easy reach and transitions beautifully from the terminal to a lunch reservation to your beach chair. And sometimes? Bringing both means you're excellent at planning ahead. Here are a few favorites to help you find the right travel companion: Travel Backpacks: Your Hands-free Best Friend For Maximum Organization: XL Clarion Backpack Some trips involve a charger, headphones, snacks, an extra layer, a book, three things you promised to carry for someone else, and approximately 47 tiny essentials. The XL Clarion Backpack is ready to handle it all. At 19.5” high, this extra large backpack gives everything a place thanks to five exterior zip compartments, two side pockets, and an interior filled with six slip pockets, a pen slip, and a zip pocket. An interior carabiner clip offers another handy spot for keys or essentials you don't want buried, while adjustable shoulder straps and an adjustable chest strap make this women's backpack especially appealing for travel days when you expect to be on the move. In other words: your hands are free, your essentials are sorted, and nobody has to dig to find what they need. 🌟Pro tip: Take your backpack organization to the next level with a makeup bag, jewelry case and more fun organizing accessories for your next trip. For Plenty of Space Without Going XL: Large Clarion Backpack Want the organizational personality of the XL Clarion in a slightly slimmer silhouette? Meet the Large Clarion Backpack. It shares many of the same travel-friendly details, including adjustable shoulder and chest straps, two exterior side pockets and plenty of interior organization. Four exterior zip compartments make frequently used items easy to separate, while six interior slip pockets, a pen slip, zip pocket and carabiner clip help keep the main compartment from becoming a free-for-all. This large but lightweight backpack is a smart choice when your itinerary includes airport corridors, sightseeing, public transportation, or any other situation where hands-free wins. When Your Packing List Has a Packing List: XL Bancroft Backpack There's prepared, and then there's "XL Bancroft" prepared. The XL Bancroft Backpack shows off its storage prowess with three spacious zip compartments, a dedicated laptop zip pocket, a tablet sleeve, and expandable side pockets designed to accommodate a variety of water bottle sizes. There's also a trolley sleeve, so you can slip the backpack over your luggage handle for an easy-carry option while rushing through the airport. And when your packing list grows? A zip expansion panel at the base adds two inches of depth. Because sometimes “just the essentials” develops its own definition halfway through packing. Thoughtful details continue inside, with multiple slip pockets, a zip pocket and a pen slip, plus a front ring for keys or charms. For longer travel days or adventures that require more gear, this backpack understands the assignment. For Business Trips and Weekend Departures: Large Bancroft Backpack The Large Bancroft Backpack lives at the intersection of polished and practical. It accommodates up to a 15” laptop and includes three compartments, a front zip pocket, multiple interior slip pockets, and a zip pocket. A trolley sleeve makes navigating with all of your luggage much easier, while two side slip pockets, keep grab-and-go necessities close. There's even a front ring for keychains or charms, because practical does not mean personality-free. For travelers moving between airport, hotel, and work meetings, this backpack keeps technology and everyday essentials organized without looking like you borrowed your hiking bag for the occasion. 🌟Pro tip: Add a coordinating cord organizer pouch to wrangle your chargers, earbuds and other tech accessories so charging your phone doesn't require a frantic five-minute search. For Walking-Heavy Adventures: Large Berkhill Backpack City wandering, museum hopping, or a full day exploring somewhere new are all backpack territory. The lightweight, casual Large Berkhill Backpack is designed for an active day, with adjustable straps, two exterior zip pockets, two side pockets and a compartment that accommodates up to a 15” laptop. A trolley sleeve adds airport convenience, while interior slip and zip pockets keep smaller belongings under control. If your ideal women's backpack for travel needs to move easily from flight day to sightseeing day, the Berkhill makes a compelling case. Tote Bags for Travel: Get the Best of Both Worlds Backpacks may win for hands-free convenience, but totes have their own travel superpowers: wide openings, easy access, and the ability to move from travel bag to everyday carryall without missing a beat. For Airport Organization: Knollton Tote Bag Our Knollton Tote Bag was made with travel in mind. Its spacious silhouette includes a zip main compartment, dedicated zip laptop pocket, and back zip pocket with a webbing trolley sleeve inside. It holds a 15" laptop, while three interior slip pockets and a zip pocket help organize everything from travel documents to chargers. If you're searching for a travel tote bag with a zipper that feels polished enough for work trips but roomy enough for weekend departures, the Knollton is ready for boarding. For Spacious, Simple Carrying: Marston Grand Tote Bag The Marston Grand Tote Bag keeps things refreshingly uncomplicated. Its roomy interior gives you space for the extras that inevitably join the trip, while an interior zip pocket and key loop keep smaller necessities easy to find. Its generous 21.75” top width also makes it easy to reach inside when you need something quickly, a definite advantage when your passport is somewhere in there and you're finally at the front of the TSA line. For travelers who like a spacious women's travel tote without an abundance of compartments, Marston keeps the experience simple. 🌟Pro tip: When you're the kind of traveler who always says “throw it in, we might need it!”, use small, medium, and large pouches to make every little thing easy to find. For Two Looks in One: Hathaway Tote Bag Packing space is precious. A reversible bag? We respect the efficiency. The Hathaway Tote Bag features a reversible design, quilted cotton lining, exterior and interior slip pockets, and a hidden magnetic closure. Its versatile shape works beautifully for vacation days when you want a lighter carryall for shopping, sightseeing, or dinner. And because it reverses, changing up your look doesn't require finding room for another bag. Your suitcase approves. For a Vera Bradley Classic: The Original Vera Tote The Original Vera Tote knows a thing or two about going places. Its roomy interior includes six slip pockets, while exterior slip and zip pockets make frequently used essentials easier to grab. A zip closure keeps the main compartment secure, and quilted cotton lining brings that unmistakable Vera Bradley feel. With a 12” handle drop and generous proportions, it's an easygoing women's travel tote bag for road trips, weekend getaways, and days when you would simply rather carry than wear your bag. 🌟Pro tip: When you're packing the big suitcase, add our soft cotton Small Original Vera Tote, which is just the right size to bring your style on the road. For Zip-It-and-Go Ease: The Original Zip Tote Bag For anyone who loves the classic tote experience but prefers everything securely zipped inside, there's the Original Zip Tote Bag. This roomy carryall features a full zip closure, 12” handle drop, exterior slip pocket, two interior slip pockets, and an interior zip pocket. It's versatile enough to move from travel day to everyday life long after you've unpacked. If a travel tote bag with a zipper is high on your wish list, this one makes a strong argument for Team Tote. Keep Track of All of the Little Things: 3 Pouch Organizer Set Whichever bag you choose, organization gets even easier with the 3 Pouch Organizer Set. The set includes three zippered pouches in large, medium, and small sizes, making it easy to create your own system inside a backpack or tote. Think tech accessories in one, personal essentials in another, and all those tiny things that otherwise disappear precisely when you need them in the third. The Power Move: Bring the Backpack and the Tote Too! Who says you have to choose? Pairing a backpack with a tote gives you flexibility throughout the trip. Use your backpack for hands-free airport navigation or walking-heavy days, then switch to your tote when you want easier access to essentials or a more relaxed carryall. A tote can also hold those last-minute additions that mysteriously appear between leaving home and reaching your gate. When it comes to your next trip, sometimes the answer is both! articles.summary: The best fall purse doesn't have to carry your entire life from September until Christmas. This season, smaller silhouettes, tactile materials, and playful finishing touches make a strong case for carrying only what you need, and making every detail count. Think polished leather with denim. Soft corduroy against a crisp jacket. A silk scarf knotted around a handle. A tiny bear hanging from a bag that otherwise means business. When it comes to handbag styling, there's no single formula. Pick the shape, texture, and extras that feel like you, then make them your own. Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag: Your Outfit's Very Capable Plus-One Our Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag in leather has that polished, pulled-together look that plays especially well with fall layers. Its clean silhouette makes it an easy match for everything from wide-leg denim and loafers to a midi skirt and tall boots. And because the adjustable strap is removable, you can change how the bag sits with your look. Carry it closer to the shoulder when you want a classic profile, or add the longer strap when your outfit calls for a different proportion. Inside, a zip pocket keeps smaller essentials together without overcomplicating things. Pair it with the Small Deluxe Tab Wallet in leather for an equally streamlined companion. At just 4 ¼" wide, it keeps your ID, cards, and cash organized in a compact shape that leaves plenty of room for the rest of your essentials. How we'd style it: When it comes to styling a leather purse for fall, choose tonal neutrals, a favorite knit and one unexpected accent like patterned shoes, statement earrings, or a silk scarf. Polished does not have to mean predictable. Mini Clara in Corduroy: Texture Is the Outfit The Mini Clara purse in corduroy taps into one of fall's great pleasures: texture. Its curved silhouette feels modern, while corduroy adds a little touch of softness and nostalgia to the mix. At 9" wide, it stays firmly in small-bag territory, with two interior credit card slips that make it easier to travel light. The compact proportions also make it a natural match for fall's more substantial pieces like oversized outerwear, chunky sweaters, or relaxed denim, without competing with them. How we'd style it: Let the corduroy do the talking. Pair a corduroy purse with smoother fabrics like denim, wool, or leather to create contrast. Small Original Vera Tote: A Classic Rethought Some classics don't need reinventing. They just need the proportions tweaked. The Small Original Vera Tote in full-grain leather brings the familiar Original Vera Tote shape into a more compact silhouette. The leather gives it a refined fall feel, while the exterior slip pocket and six interior slip pockets make organization easy without turning the bag into a filing cabinet. With an 11 ½" square body and a wider 16 ¼" top, it has enough presence to anchor an outfit while still feeling lighter and more streamlined than a larger tote. Prefer pattern and quilting? The Small Original Vera Tote is also available in classic premium cotton with a quilted cotton lining, giving you another way to interpret the same iconic silhouette. How we'd style it: Use a leather tote as a grounding piece with prints and layered color, or let a soft quilted cotton tote become the focal point of a simpler look. Your bag doesn't have to match. Maisie Handbag in Denim: Denim Does Dress Up The denim Maisie Handbag is proof that classics have all the fun. Its compact 8" wide silhouette has a clean, timeless shape, but denim gives it a more relaxed point of view. That combination makes it especially easy to style for fall, when wardrobes naturally start mixing structured pieces with softer, more casual layers. Finish with two small exterior slip pockets to keep frequently reached-for items close, while the zip closure keeps the silhouette neat. How we'd style it: That old rule about not mixing denim? Consider this your permission slip to ignore it. Pair a denim purse with corduroy. Add a denim crossbody to a trench. Carry a patchwork denim tote bag with a dress and boots. Or try denim-on-denim if that's your thing! Original 100 Handbag: The One That Started Something There are throwbacks, and then there are originals. The quilted cotton Original 100 Handbag brings back the silhouette that helped start the Vera Bradley story, thoughtfully crafted for the way we carry now. It features three exterior slip pockets, five interior slip pockets, and a soft quilted cotton lining, balancing recognizable Vera Bradley design with plenty of everyday function. How we'd style it: For fall, the Original 100's classic shape gives you room to play with pattern. Pair it with solid separates, mix it with another print or take the maximalist route and keep going. Amanda Shoulder Bag: Add New Shape to the Rotation The Amanda Shoulder Bag in premium quilted cotton has a slim, vertical silhouette that adds a different proportion to fall looks. It's stylishly spacious without feeling oversized, with an exterior slip pocket, two interior slip pockets, and an interior zip pocket. And there's another texture joining the story: the Amanda Shoulder Bag will also be available in Velvet later in the fall, just in time for your holiday celebration. Because once the calendar starts filling up, a little velvet makes a very good argument for itself. How we'd style it: Pair it with straight-leg jeans and a sweater, a long coat and boots, or whatever combination is currently winning the bedroom-chair audition. How to Style a Handbag Without Overthinking It Wondering how to style your handbag so it feels more personal? Start with the part that has absolutely nothing to do with rules: choose something you like. Then add another thing you like! That's where scarves and bag charms come in. They're an easy way to change the attitude of a favorite handbag from one outfit or one day to the next. Square Silk Scarf: Tie It Up The Square Silk Scarf is printed silk in a versatile 25 ½" square, giving you plenty of ways to make it part of your look. Knot it around a handbag handle. Tie it into a loose bow. Wrap it around your neck and let the bag stay simple. Style it in your hair. There isn't a test later. A silk scarf also creates a particularly interesting contrast against rich materials like leather, denim, and corduroy. Smooth meets textured. Polished meets playful. Everybody wins. Bag Charms: Your Handbag Has Hobbies Now Bag charms have a way of turning a handbag into your handbag. They add color, movement, texture, and, occasionally, a tiny bear, all of which seem important. The Original Tote Bag Charm takes an instantly recognizable tote silhouette and shrinks it down to a playful accessory, complete with classic quilted cotton and a zip closure. Consider it a Vera Bradley tote for your Vera Bradley tote! For something a little softer, the adorable Bitty Bear Bag Charm brings personality to handbags, totes, and keys alike. Available in premium cotton and corduroy, it's an especially fun way to bring another fall texture into your look. Want something that gets noticed? The Beaded Bird Bag Charm adds a decorative, conversation-starting detail with an easy-to-attach hinge ring. The Bird Earbud Bag Charm proves a charming accessory can have a job, too. Its zippered design accommodates most earbuds, while the patchwork style makes it an easy companion for the season's casual looks. Your earbuds have officially moved into a nicer apartment. And for a floral moment that isn't remotely concerned with the temperature outside, the Floral Bag Charm brings a pop of color and movement with its elongated faux-leather design. This Fall, Follow Your Own Bag Rules Leather or corduroy. Denim or soft cotton. Compact shoulder bag or small tote. One charm or enough charms to require introductions. The right fall fashion handbag is the one that works with your style. Start with a silhouette you're drawn to, play with the season's richer materials, then add scarves, charms, and other details until it feels unmistakably yours. SHOP ALL FALL HANDBAGS & ACCESSORIES
articles.title: How to Upgrade Your Handbag Style This Fall

articles.summary: Some trips are carefully planned while others come together at the last minute. Either way, the backpack you bring can shape the entire experience. The best one feels comfortable from the airport to the hotel, keeps your essentials organized, and leaves your hands free for everything the day has in store. There isn't one perfect travel backpack for women because every traveler moves differently. Some pack light for sightseeing, while others need space for a laptop, travel documents, or an extra layer. Whether you're looking for a travel backpack as a carry-on, a bag for active adventures, or an everyday companion for weekend escapes, choosing the right style starts with how you like to travel. Best Backpack for Frequent Flyers Frequent flyers know the routine. One trip might mean a quick overnight, while the next includes long layovers, connecting flights, and hours spent moving through the airport. The right bag makes those transitions feel easier. The Large Berkhill Backpack is a smart choice if you're looking for a highly packable backpack for travel that can handle changing plans without feeling bulky. Its clean, understated style works just as well on a business trip as it does for a weekend escape, while multiple zip pockets and interior organization help keep travel documents, chargers, pens, and other essentials exactly where you expect them to be. Favorite features: • Built-in trolley sleeve slides securely over your rolling luggage • Roomy interior and dedicated pockets keep everything within easy reach • Padded compartment holds a laptop up to 15 inches for queuing up a movie or getting some work done • Side pockets are ideal for a water bottle or umbrella Best Carry-On Backpack for International Travel International travel often means making every inch of your carry-on count. Whether you're hopping between cities or settling in for a long-haul flight, small details make a big difference on longer trips. The Bancroft Backpack is an excellent option for anyone searching for the best carry-on backpack for international travel. Two spacious zip compartments create room for clothing, travel accessories, and in-flight essentials, while a separate laptop compartment keeps your computer protected and easy to access during security screening. Favorite features: • Front organizer pocket to passports, charging cables, and pens neatly arranged • Expandable water bottle pocket that fits a variety of bottle sizes • Trolley sleeve so the backpack can ride comfortably on your rolling suitcase • Exterior ring to conveniently clip bag charms or keys so they're always easy to find "The perfect backpack for my upcoming trip - lightweight and just the right size for my personal item for the plane with enough room for my laptop, medication and other travel essentials." ~ Carol Best Backpack for Sightseers Some of the best travel memories happen when you're simply wandering. A museum catches your eye. A side street leads to a new favorite café. A local market turns into an afternoon well spent. A lightweight backpack for travel lets you enjoy those moments without constantly adjusting what you're carrying. Our Lorman Sling Backpack is made for days when you want to pack light without giving up organization. Its slim silhouette stays close to your body, making it comfortable to wear while walking through busy streets, browsing local shops, or navigating public transportation. This is a practical companion for travelers who prefer to move freely with just what they need. Favorite features: • Two zip compartments to keep everyday essentials organized • Interior slip pocket provides a dedicated place for smaller items • Adjustable strap so you can customize the fit • Lightweight for continuous comfort from morning until evening "Just the right bag in an on the go travel environment. Designed to wear on your front or back to always have an eye on things." ~ Robyn Best Backpack for Active Travelers Some itineraries rarely sit still. You might spend the morning on a trail, the afternoon exploring a waterfront, and the evening meeting friends for dinner. A backpack that keeps up with all of it makes every stop a little easier. The Small Banbury Backpack is compact enough to stay comfortable while you're on the move, yet thoughtfully organized for your daily essentials. Its colorful patchwork pattern brings signature Vera Bradley personality to every outing while remaining easy to pair with casual travel wardrobes. Favorite features: • Two zip compartments to separate your belongings • Interior pockets help keep smaller items organized • Exterior side pockets for quick access to a water bottle • Back slip pocket for your phone or items you want close at hand • Adjustable straps so you're comfortable whether it's an hour or an entire day exploring "I love this backpack -- the size is perfect, and of course there are plenty of pockets to store things in." ~ Deborah Best Daypack for Travel The most useful travel bags rarely serve just one purpose. They carry everything you need for the flight (and delays just in case), hold your essentials while you're sightseeing, and still have room for the extras you pick up along the way. The Westover Hybrid Backpack is a versatile day backpack for travel that easily shifts between travel days and everyday adventures. Dedicated compartments for both a laptop and tablet help protect your electronics, while generous interior space gives you room for everything from an extra sweater to travel necessities. It's a clean, versatile design that transitions easily from the terminal to the city streets. Favorite features: • Lay flat design for easy packing and re-packing • Interior organization pockets and compression straps so everything stays neat • Zippered water bottle pocket to keep hydration close at hand • Trolley sleeve so you can navigate the airport comfortably "The size is perfect for weekend travel! I love that you can fully open it like a suitcase. It's also pretty lightweight which is good." ~ Lapkwan The Right Backpack Is the One That Fits Your Journey No two trips look exactly alike, and that's part of the fun. Whether you're packing for an international adventure, a weekend getaway, a day of sightseeing, or an active escape, the right backpack helps you stay organized while leaving room for the moments you didn't plan. Vera Bradley's collection of travel-ready backpacks combines practical features with signature patterns, beautiful colors, and styles made to travel wherever inspiration leads. Choose the one that fits your journey, pack what matters most, and make room for whatever comes next. SHOP ALL TRAVEL BACKPACKS
